title: Coast Guard rescues 7 in 2 cases off Georgia coast
description: The Coast Guard rescued seven people in two separate search and rescue cases Nov. 10, 2020, off the Georgia coast. Florida is experiencing a lot of rain and gale-force winds coming in from Hurrican ETA. (U.S. Coast guard Video)
